mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_log (user_id, product_id, type, score) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{type}, #{score})
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, SUM(score) AS agg_score FROM behavior_log WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY agg_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
